thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 alert — session-retry surge in us-west-2 (svc: inference-gateway). Error rate > 6% for last 5m. Paging oncall. Alert link: https://alerts.redwood.example/1785432109

alia (oncall): seeing it. investigating now.

matt (infra): oncall, any clue if infra deploys landed in us-west-2 last 30m?

alia (oncall): not from me. checking deploy history...

incident-bot: recent deploys: 
- commit ae3f9 pushed to canary 1785430011 by sree
- infra: autoscaler bump merged 1785429900 by matt

alia (oncall): timeline so far: spike started ~1785432050. top traces show many 502s from gateway -> runtime mux.

sree (runtime): pulling logs for gateway and runtime. can someone run a quick `curl` against health check?

tina-devex: running a quick curl from us-west-2 host now:
```
curl -i https://gateway-usw2.redwood-internal/health
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
X-Request-Id: req_0a7f
```

karen-ps: customers on us-west-2 may see elevated latency. I've flagged CS to hold any escalations.

matt (infra): checking infra metrics: node CPU modest, network not saturated, but there's a burst of TCP resets around the same time. also noticing LB target deregisters transiently.

alia (oncall): copying relevant logs here (gateway tail):
```
[1785432053] WARN conn: upstream reset by peer code=RST35 target=runtime-03
[1785432054] ERROR proxy: write failed: broken pipe
[1785432056] INFO router: retrying request id=req_0a7f attempt=2
[1785432060] ERROR gateway: request failed: upstream 502
```

sree (runtime): runtime logs show KV cache thrash and OOM-ish entries on runtime-03 around 1785432048:
```
[1785432048] WARN kvcache: eviction pressure high, mem_used=92%
[1785432050] ERROR runtime: memory alloc failed: OutOfMemory
[1785432051] INFO runtime: graceful restart initiated
```

alia (oncall): hypothesis A: a runtime node (runtime-03) hit memory pressure, restarted and caused upstream resets and retries -> amplified retries at gateway -> 5xx surge.

matt (infra): hypothesis B: recent autoscaler change (merged earlier) increased aggressive scaling churn for small bursts and caused ephemeral target flaps. that would explain target deregisters and resets.

sree (runtime): agree both could be true. looks like runtime-03 got a new heavier model shard after canary rollout (ae3f9). I'll check the canary config vs prod.

alia (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) take runtime-03 out of rotation (manual drain) 2) roll gateway retry down to 0 for us-west-2 for short window 3) escalate if errors persist. who can own each?

matt (infra): I will drain runtime-03 and pin autoscaler to stable policy. executing drain now: `k runbook drain runtime-03 --grace 30s`

sree (runtime): I'll rollback canary commit ae3f9 on runtime group if we see similar restarts on other nodes. prepared to revert: `deploy revert ae3f9 --target runtime`

alia (oncall): applying gateway retry tweak: `set-config gateway.usw2.retries=0 --temp 15m` now.

incident-bot: action logs: matt drained runtime-03 @1785432280; alia changed gateway retries @1785432305; sree put revert on hold pending follow-up @1785432350.

karen-ps: customer impact note: ~3% of requests failed with 502 between 1785432050-1785432220, affecting long-running sessions. notifying 2 enterprise customers (ids C-119, C-202).

matt (infra): after drain, LB shows steady targets, no more TCP resets in last 2m. CPU and mem back to normal across nodes.

alia (oncall): metrics improved: error rate dropped to 0.6% at 1785432400. keeping monitoring for 30m.

sree (runtime): I dug into canary deploy: ae3f9 enabled a micro-optimization that increases in-memory KV cache prefetch for certain prompts — seems to raise peak mem by ~8% on some sequences. test harness logs attached.

alia (oncall): tracking hypotheses in-thread: H1(runtime OOM due to ae3f9 cache prefetch), owner=sree; H2(autoscaler churn from recent policy), owner=matt.

sree (runtime): quick repro locally with stress tool: `stress-infer --prompt batch-heavy --scale 4` produced similar eviction warnings. plan: run a staged revert on canary (non-prod) then on prod canary if confirmed. ETA 20m.

matt (infra): I'll revert autoscaler commit in a scoped way: revert aggressive backoff changes only. will target canary autoscaler groups first. ETA 15m.

alia (oncall): if both mitigations drop error rate to baseline, we'll keep them and schedule RCA. if not, escalate to full rollback of ae3f9.

incident-bot: page update: oncall reassigned to matt at 1785432700 for infra follow-up. (handoff recorded).

karen-ps: prepping customer-facing summary (short) — will send once we confirm final status after 30m window.

sree (runtime): revert test on canary completed: when removing the prefetch flag memory footprint drops ~9% and no eviction logs under same stress. staging hold looks stable.

matt (infra): autoscaler tweak revert done in canary groups, monitoring. no more target de-registrations observed.

alia (oncall): rolling status: error rate back to 0.2% at 1785433050. keeping thread open for RCA write-up.

sree (runtime): decisions: 1) revert ae3f9 prefetch in prod canary at 1785433150 (owner=sree) 2) revert autoscaler aggressive policy in prod after validation (owner=matt) 3) create follow-up eval set to measure memory delta and perf impact (owner=tina-devex).

karen-ps: sent customer note to C-119 and C-202 summarizing impact and mitigation @1785433200.

alia (oncall): final notes for RCA: collect timeline (this thread), attach logs (gateway tail + runtime logs), record hypothesis list and owners, link to revert PRs and metrics dashboards. I'll open RCA doc now and add initial timeline.

tina-devex: I'll prepare the eval harness and perf vs quality checklist. adding to the RCA doc.

incident-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. initial P0 closed for paging at 1785433499 (oncall: alia).

alia (oncall): closing thread for active paging. RCA doc link: https://docs.redwood.example/rca/1785432109-session-retry-surge (will fill details). thanks all for fast response. :heart:
